Maya (Finance): Heads up — canary rollout of the new rate sheet started at 13:00 UTC and we're seeing ~0.8% of invoices with unexpected line items (grandfathered SKUs billed at new rate).
Samir (Billing): Ugh. Do we know which cohort these users are in? A/B tag mismatch?
Maya (Finance): Early canary cohort = cohort_C. I pulled 42 invoices so far that have the mismatch. Attached sample: INV-1002345 shows new rate applied but metadata says grandfathered=true.
Eden (Eng): I'm checking routing — the pricekey used at request time should be coming from the pricing flag service. Might be a cache propagation issue between price-service and billing-cache.
finance-bot: Invoice generation job completed for batch 2026-03-23T13:02Z. Processed 12,432 invoices. 42 warnings flagged for rate-discrepancy. See /ops/logs/invoice_gen/2267894321.log
Liam (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice lines? Also need SQL snippet to reproduce.
Maya (Finance): Pasting sample query I used to find mismatches:
```
SELECT i.id, i.user_id, i.created_at, p.rate_key, p.grandfathered_flag
FROM invoices i
JOIN invoice_lines l ON l.invoice_id = i.id
JOIN pricing_snapshot p ON p.rate_key = l.rate_key
WHERE i.created_at >= '2026-03-23' AND p.grandfathered_flag = true AND l.billed_rate != p.expected_rate;
```
Rafa (Revenue): Important: if cohort_C was supposed to be grandfathered until 2026-06-01 we need a rollback or credit plan. What's the blast radius?
Samir (Billing): Preliminary numbers: 42 invoices, estimate $1.2k in overcharge. But could increase as logs roll. Recommend pause canary traffic for cohort_C and re-run generation with corrected snapshot.
Eden (Eng): Confirmed: price flag propagation delayed ~35s due to cache TTL misconfig after we pushed the new rate sheet. The price-service returned old data to the billing worker which then applied the new rate (race). Patch: invalidate cache on publish and extend canary-check to 60s.
Maya (Finance): Proposed ops: 1) Pause cohort_C canary now (Samir) 2) Recompute invoices for flagged batch & create credit adjustments (Billing Ops) 3) Notify legal & revenue for approvals (Rafa) 4) Postmortem and add automated diff-check before full rollout (Eden).
Liam (Billing Ops): On it — pausing cohort_C traffic. I'll queue a recalculation job and tag all affected users for manual review. ETA 45m.
Rafa (Revenue): Approve credits up to $5k without exec signoff. If we exceed, escalate to CFO. Please log approvals here when done. :white_check_mark:
Samir (Billing): After recalculation we should run these checks: checksum of pricing_snapshot at invoice_time, compare to published rate sheet id, run sample-redrive on 100 invoices.
Maya (Finance): Noted. I'll compile a customer-facing note template for affected accounts if we need to reach out.
Eden (Eng): I'll ship the cache invalidation hotfix to canary and add a pre-rollout gating job that fails the publish if any billing worker reports a mismatch in a 5m smoke window.
finance-bot: Action created: INC-2267894321 (billing-mismatch-canary). Assigned to Liam.
Maya (Finance): Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread. I'll update stakeholders at 14:30 UTC unless we have a major change before then. :clock1:
